messages:
kai_sales: Quick heads-up — CloudBridge wants a joint POC (embeddings + decisioning). Key asks: embeddings ingest ~1k QPS, embed P95 <=80ms, decision LM P95 <=200ms, private connect, drift telemetry. They also sent a security questionnaire and want a pricing sketch. Can eng/ops/sec triage?

alex_pm: Good summary. Do we know preferred deployment: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private? That will drive infra and pricing.

cloud_bridge_rep: We prefer Hosted with Private Connect (VPC egress) initially. Will consider Dedicated if Hosted can't meet latency SLA. Models: rwd-embed-8k and rwd-decision-7B. Index ~30M short texts.

maya_eng: embedding QPS is non-trivial. Are clients batching on their side? Batch size/dist will change latency significantly. Also need exact percentile targets (P50/P95/P99).

kai_sales: They specified embeddings P95 <= 80ms; decisioning P95 <= 200ms. They want batching transparent to them.

dino_infra: For Hosted + Private Connect we can pin traffic to a regional fleet and enable prefix/KV caching. For decisioning token-level <50ms tails we may need Dedicated with optimized kernels + larger GPU SKUs. Need expected prompt lengths and token counts.

nina_sec: Received their questionnaire. Highlights: SOC2, data residency, KMS/HSM options, deletion certificates, network ACLs, and separation of customer data. Procurement will require the vendor risk form answered before contract.

alex_pm: Actions: (1) Eng: produce per-model latency feasibility and a perf probe (2) Sec: start questionnaire responses and list hard blockers (3) Finance: pricing sketch Hosted vs Dedicated for target QPS (4) Schedule a 60-min arch workshop with partner this week.

maya_eng: I'll run a perf probe simulating 1k QPS with different client batching profiles. ETA EOD. I'll also post a small curl smoke test they can use:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-8k","input":["a","b","c"]}'
```

maya_eng: Note: for Private Connect we ask partners to either allow egress to a small CIDR set or configure PrivateLink. For test perf we'll provide a recommended test CIDR (10.48.0.0/22) and final IPs after workshop.

dino_infra: Cost control idea: propose a Dedicated reserved baseline sized for steady-state embeddings plus Hosted burst for spikes. I'll draft delta-cost slides comparing pure Hosted vs hybrid vs Dedicated.

nina_sec: Early blockers: (A) They require on-prem HSM for key storage — Hosted supports cloud KMS only; Dedicated/Private can support HSM options but require extra procurement/ops. (B) They want 30-day auto-delete for all logs; platform default retains some telemetry at 90d. Propose a contractual data retention override for POC and implement scoped redaction/short retention in the POC env.

alex_pm: Let's do a quick internal sync at 14:00 PST. Invite: kai_sales, maya_eng, dino_infra, nina_sec, finance. Kai will bring CloudBridge tech for the workshop.

cloud_bridge_rep: 14:00 PST works for us. We'll upload the filled questionnaire with redlines before the sync. Thanks :raised_hands: 

deploybot: Canary deploy scheduled for rwd-embed-8k perf build at 13:30 PST — will post perf metrics in this thread once healthy.

maya_eng: Once canary completes I'll share P50/P95/P99 for the sample workload. If P95 degrades >20% vs baseline we recommend moving to Dedicated sizing.

kai_sales: I'll prep a 1-slide procurement ask (SOC2 report + timeline) and attach it to the invite.

alex_pm: Perfect. After internal sync we'll produce: workshop agenda, perf readout, pricing sketch, and Sec's questionnaire draft. Goal: kickoff POC next week.
